ऊम्: ऊम् ind. An interjection of (a) interrogation; (b) anger; (c) reproach, abuse; (d) arrogance; (e) envy.
ऊम: ऊम a. Protecting. --मः Ved. A good friend, an affectionate companion.
ऊय्: ऊय् {c1c} A. [ऊयते, ऊत] To weave, sew.
